title: Closed fill of a dry horizontal conduit, scored on cycle-averaged equilibrium (revision 2 of PV-TF1)
registrationStatus: PROPOSED, draft 3a (12 Nov 2026): a targeted closure pass after the technical review of draft 3 (reviews/review-r2-draft3-2026-11-12.md), which accepted R3'' and the design and required four changes (D4 in the validity logic, the Froude condition, depth-endpoint guards, an absolute-value statement). Drafts 1-3 the same day; drafts 2 and 3 preserved in drafts/. Not hashed, not registered, not run, not in spec/. For independent review once the technical reviewer confirms 3a; no execution or registration is authorised. The original PV-TF1 registration (spec/PV-TF1.json) and run 1 (results/2026-11-12T15-00-21-588Z) are unchanged
supersedesForFutureExecution: PV-TF1 (registered 12 Nov 2026): its instantaneous at-rest design is not executed again (decision of 12 Nov 2026). Its run 1 and statuses stand as recorded
process: a dry conduit filling from one end in a closed system, then oscillating freely; storage at intermediate junctions and in the conduit, judged on cycle-averaged end-state quantities whose allowances are computed from the recorded motion
module: transient/pv-tf1-r2.mjs (not written; to be written only after approval)
relatedSpecs: PV-TF1 (its geometry, inflow, guards, hard validity conditions and sealing device are carried unchanged)
PV-C1 (its closure and level criteria are carried)
derivation: milestone2/pv-tf1-r2/DERIVATION.md (draft 3); every derived number is computed by milestone2/pv-tf1-r2/derive.mjs into derived.json from the declared inputs only; the changes from draft 2 are listed in CHANGELOG.md and the status of every conclusion in DERIVATION.md section 11
equations: E1 continuity of the closed system: after the inflow ends, the stored volume is constant, V_in = 180.0 m^3 (no outflow: the sealing weir must never flow)

E2 representation volume (the books), at every routing step: V_b(t) = A_t d_T1 + A_t d_T2 + sum_s V_s(y_i, y_i+1) + sum_j NODE_VOLUME_j, V_s the volume of segment s for a linear water surface between its two recorded end depths (references/volume.mjs conduitVolumeLinearSurface); window mean <V_b>_w over every step of window w

E3 definition sensitivity (representation-volume closure): C_fn,w = max_{t in w} sum_s (L_s / 12) max|dW/dy|_{s,t} (y_i(t) - y_i+1(t))^2, max|dW/dy|_{s,t} taken over [min(y_i(t), y_i+1(t)), max(y_i(t), y_i+1(t))], the complete depth range of segment s at step t (|dW/dy| = |D - 2y| / sqrt(y (D - y)) is monotone in |y - D/2|, so it is attained at an end of that range); evaluated only under the depth-endpoint guard G-depth. It bounds the difference between the linear-surface volume (the reference) and the trapezoidal or midpoint volume of the same node depths

E4 reference link equation (lumped St Venant with Manning, horizontal, per segment s between nodes i and i+1): H_i - H_i+1 = (L_s / (g Abar)) dQ/dt + L_s n^2 Q|Q| / (Abar^2 Rbar^(4/3)) - (1 / (g Abar)) [2 L_s v dAbar/dt + v^2 (A_i+1 - A_i)], Abar = A(ybar), Rbar = R(ybar), ybar = (y_i + y_i+1) / 2, v = Q / Abar, A_i = A(y_i)

E5 predicted mean head difference (E4 averaged over the n steps of window w, in its backward-Euler form): P_s,w = I_s + F_s - C_s, I_s = (L_s / (g n dt)) sum_{t in w} (Q_t - Q_t-1) / Abar_t, F_s = <L_s n^2 Q|Q| / (Abar^2 Rbar^(4/3))>_w, C_s = <(1 / (g Abar)) [2 L_s v (Abar_t - Abar_t-1) / dt + v^2 (A_i+1 - A_i)]>_w; every term from recorded flows and depths

E6 uniformity: U_w = max over every node j (both tanks and every junction) of |<WSE_j>_w - hbar_w|, hbar_w = (<WSE_T1>_w + <WSE_T2>_w) / 2. With the measured mean head difference M_s,w = <H_i - H_i+1>_w and the momentum residual r_s,w = M_s,w - P_s,w (D4), the bound from the record is U_w <= tau_U,w + R_U,w, tau_U,w = (1/2) sum_s |P_s,w| (explained by the reference equation), R_U,w = (1/2) sum_s |r_s,w| (not explained)

E7 level identity (exact): hbar_w - h_eq = [(<V_b>_w - V_in) - sum_j S_j <u_j>_w - <R2>_w] / Stilde, u_j = y_j - hbar_w, S_j = W(hbar_w) L / N (junction lumped area), Stilde = (V_level(hbar_w) - V_level(h_eq)) / (hbar_w - h_eq) >= 2 A_t + L min W; |R2(t)| <= (1/2) sum_s L_s max|dW/dy|_{s,t} max(u_i(t)^2, u_i+1(t)^2), max|dW/dy|_{s,t} over [min(hbar_w, y_i(t), y_i+1(t)), max(hbar_w, y_i(t), y_i+1(t))], under G-depth

E8 level redistribution allowance (measured; uses no reference link equation): E_h,w = [|sum_j S_j <u_j>_w| + <Rbound2>_w] / (2 A_t + L min W), with <u_j>_w the recorded junction mean deviations and Rbound2 the bound of E7

E8a Froude number of segment s at step t (a condition of the source correspondence): Fr_s(t) = |Q_s(t) / Abar_s(t)| / sqrt(g Abar_s(t) / Wbar_s(t)), Abar and Wbar at ybar = (y_i + y_i+1) / 2 (as SWMM link_getFroude: |v| / sqrt(g A/W) at yMid, link.c lines 847-871)
E9 reference level: h_eq from 2 A_t h + L A_circle(h) = V_in (references/volume.mjs equilibriumDepth), 0.506637 m

E10 reference periods (window length and diagnostics only): N = 1, the two-node lumped period 2 pi / sqrt(g A (1/S_1 + 1/S_2) / L), S_i = A_t + W L / 2; N >= 4, the fundamental of the frictionless linearised lumped network (node area = tank area + half of each joined conduit's top width x length; link inertance L_s / (g A)), at h_eq
referenceAssumptions: R1'' the reference dynamic model is the lumped network of E4 at resolution N. It enters only the uniformity allowance (E5, E6) and the periods (E10); since draft 3a the level allowance (E8) does not use it. That SWMM's EXTRAN link update is the backward-Euler form of E4 is a fact about the source (dwflow.c lines 192-240: dq1-dq4 with sigma = rho = 1, so aWtd = aMid, rWtd = rMid), conditional on: Froude number <= 0.5 (dwflow.c line 192); both ends wet (y > FUDGE); not full; zero offsets, so that getFlowClass returns SUBCRITICAL (dwflow.c lines 331-335). The exceptions are the lagged |v| and the under-relaxation of q between iterations (line 265), the normal-flow limiter (BOTH, lines 255-258), the flow-reversal rule (line 266) and the dry-end rule (lines 280-281). The conditions are checked by G-reference; the exceptions are measured by r_s (D4), which G-reference bounds
R2 the tanks are prismatic, 20 m^2, invert 0 (checked by the node-volume row)

R3'' the closure reference is the representation volume E2: the geometric volume implied by the recorded node depths through a linear surface in each segment. The physical water profile between nodes is not part of the reference; it is not part of SWMM's state and cannot be observed. Its sensitivity is reported (diagnostic D5), never scored. At rest the representation volume and the physical volume coincide
R4 junctions have zero plan area and zero volume; SWMM's junction volume is identically 0 (checked by a scored row)
R5 the declared inflow is the only source (reported row: the applied inflow against 180.0)

R6 the reference values (V_in, h_eq, T_ref) come from the declared inputs only. The allowances C_fn, tau_U, E_h are computed from the recorded state by the fixed formulas E3-E8; they are not reference values
boundaryConditions: unchanged from PV-TF1: the trapezoid hydrograph into T1, 0 -> 0.1 m^3/s over 60 s, held to 1800 s, to 0 over 60 s (180.0 m^3); the only outfall behind the sealing weir (crest 2.5 m)
geometry: unchanged from PV-TF1: T1, T2 prismatic 20 m^2, 3 m deep, invert 0; circular D 1.0 m, L 400 m, n 0.013, horizontal, zero offsets, N equal segments joined by N - 1 junctions at invert 0 (max depth 3 m); sealing weir W0 T2 -> OUT
hardValidityConditions: unchanged from PV-TF1 (V1-V4, including V3's reading of SWMM's nominal slope for a level conduit); any deviation invalidates the experiment

manningN.unit: s m^-1/3 (also the n of the reference link equation E4)

segments.unit: - (N = 1 a separate reference case; N = 4, 16, 32 the primary segmentation comparison, under the comparability rules of segmentationInterpretation)

durationS.unit: s (48 h; a fixed maximum, not a criterion; not changed after the fact)

referencePeriodS.unit: s (derived.json; sets the window length and the diagnostics; no validity condition depends on it)

scoredWindows.unit: - (K consecutive windows ending at the last routing step; closure, level and uniformity on the last; stationarity and drift across all three)

residualMotionShare.unit: - (beta: the share of a criterion or of the head tolerance that an allowance may use)

headToleranceM.unit: m (SWMM's HEAD_TOLERANCE as registered; the Passed/Qualified/Failed boundary of the uniformity row and the scale the uniformity gate protects; never a reference)

periodTolerance.unit: - (eps: a declared TOLERANCE for diagnostic D2 and the comparability rule; not an a-priori uncertainty bound; DERIVATION.md section 6)

linearityFraction.unit: - of A/W at h_eq (a_lin = 3.99 mm): diagnostic D1 only

shiftedWindows.unit: - (diagnostic D3: windows shifted back by j T_ref / 8, j = 0..7)

solver: SWMM 5.2.4 production wasm through lib/swmm-run.mjs: CMS, DYNWAVE, EXTRAN, INERTIAL_DAMPING PARTIAL, MIN_SLOPE 0, MIN_SURFAREA 1.167, fixed 1 s, MAX_TRIALS 8, HEAD_TOLERANCE 0.0015; NORMAL_FLOW_LIMITED is the experimental factor (configurations). Production settings are not changed

PRIMARY.why: SWMM 5.2.4 accepts NONE (keywords.c line 70 -> NEITHER); dwflow.c line 255 then skips checkNormalFlow, the only routing use of the nominal WARNING 04 slope (F10). The segmentation comparison is made here

PAIRED.why: the registered PV-TF1 setting and production's (src/drainage.js line 409); scored with the same criteria, tallied separately, never pooled with PRIMARY; quantifies the limiter's effect. NONE and BOTH are not assumed equivalent

diagnosticsUnscored.what: PRIMARY with a 0.5 s step: time-discretisation sensitivity of every scored quantity
PRIMARY with MIN_SURFAREA 0.1 m^2: separates P2b (junction minimum surface area)
PRIMARY on the instrumented build: conduit volume (getter 420) as a decomposition only, after an exact equality check of every recorded value against production

configurations.matrix: 4 N x {PRIMARY, PAIRED} scored = 8 cases; 4 N x 3 diagnostics = 12 unscored runs; 20 runs in all. Not authorised. INERTIAL_DAMPING NONE is dropped: it does not bear on the storage mechanism

reference.periods: milestone2/pv-tf1-r2/derive.mjs (lumped eigenvalues by Jacobi; the continuum check kL + 2 atan(A_t k / W) = m pi)
reference.independence: the reference values (180.0 m^3, h_eq, T_ref) come from the declared inputs alone; the allowances are fixed formulas declared before any run; no run-1 number enters any of them

cycleAveragedEquilibrium.windows: K = 3 consecutive windows w1, w2, w3, each windowSteps routing steps, the last ending at the final step; E5 also uses the step before each window
cycleAveragedEquilibrium.averaged: every routing step in the window, unweighted (fixed step): tank depths and WSE, every junction's WSE and NODE_VOLUME, V_b, every segment's flow and the E5 terms
gates: G-depth: every recorded node depth in w1-w3 and the step before w1 lies in [0.1 D, 0.9 D]; otherwise C_fn and the R2 bound are not evaluated (no infinite or clipped value): books and level rows IR-definition. max|dW/dy| on that interval is 2.667 (derived.json)
G-books: G-depth and C_fn,w3 <= beta closureRel V_in (0.018 m^3); else closure and stationarity rows Insufficient reference data, sub-class IR-definition

G-reference (the D4 gate; uniformity row): (a) Fr_s(t) <= 0.5 for every segment at every step of w1-w3 and the step before w1; (b) G-depth; (c) R_U,w3 <= beta headToleranceM (0.15 mm). Else the uniformity row is Insufficient reference data, sub-class IR-reference; the residual profile r_s, its cumulative form and the Froude record are preserved
G-uniformity: tau_U,w3 <= beta headToleranceM (0.15 mm); else the uniformity row IR-motion

G-level: G-depth and E_h,w3 <= beta equilibriumAbsM (0.2 mm), else IR-redistribution (IR-definition if G-depth fails); W5 holds, else IR-drift. The level row does not depend on G-reference or on the uniformity row: E8 uses the measured redistribution
W5 level drift: |hbar_wk - hbar_wk-1| <= E_h,wk + E_h,wk-1 + |<V_b>_wk - <V_b>_wk-1| / (2 A_t + L min W), k = 2, 3
cycleAveragedEquilibrium.uniformityTiers: Passed when G-uniformity and G-reference hold; U_w3 <= tau_U,w3 + R_U,w3 (<= 0.3 mm) then follows from E6 and is recorded as an arithmetic check. The row has no Qualified or Failed status. Once the residual is part of the bound (review of draft 3, item 1), U cannot exceed it, because U <= (1/2) sum_s |M_s| = (1/2) sum_s |P_s + r_s| identically. A mean head difference the reference equation does not explain appears as r_s and fails G-reference (IR-reference). Draft 3's tiers (Qualified up to tau_U + 1.5 mm, Failed beyond) are withdrawn
cycleAveragedEquilibrium.stationarityTiers: max_k |<V_b>_wk - <V_b>_wk-1|: Passed <= C_fn,wk + C_fn,wk-1 (no drift resolvable); Qualified <= beta closureRel V_in (0.018 m^3 per window); Failed (accounting) beyond: continuing drift
classification: BOUNDED NATURAL OSCILLATION: every gate holds; stationarity Passed

MEAN STATE NOT EXPLAINED BY THE REFERENCE EQUATION: G-reference fails (Froude, depth, or R_U > 0.15 mm): uniformity IR-reference. A persistent hydraulic imbalance and a departure of SWMM from E4 (limiter, flow reversal, non-convergence) are both residuals and this row does not separate them; the residual profile and the NONE/BOTH comparison (P4) are reported. The level and books rows are unaffected
CONTINUING DRIFT: stationarity Failed (accounting) and/or W5 failed (level row IR-drift)
MOTION TOO LARGE: G-uniformity fails (uniformity IR-motion) or G-level fails (level IR-redistribution); the books are unaffected
DEPTH OUT OF RANGE: G-depth fails: books and level IR-definition, uniformity IR-reference
diagnostics: D1 linearity: a_max,w (max over nodes and steps of |WSE_i - hbar_w|) against a_lin; reported
D2 period: mean zero up-crossing interval of T1 - T2 against T_ref within eps; it checks the T1 - T2 fundamental only and does not validate any other mode; reported

D3 shifted windows: <V_b>, hbar, U over 8 windows shifted by j T_ref / 8; detects a phase-dependent mean at 45 deg resolution of the fundamental; cannot detect a component whose period divides T_ref / 8, cancellations between components, or variation slower than a window; reported

D4 momentum residual: r_s,w = M_s,w - P_s,w per segment, R_U,w = (1/2) sum_s |r_s,w|, the cumulative residual profile, and the per-step Froude numbers. R_U and the Froude record are gated by G-reference (uniformity row); the profile is preserved for interpretation; the residual is never scored as a physical result
D5 physical-profile sensitivity: the monotone bracket <B>_w (PV-C1 conduitVolumeBounds) and the envelope bound 2 a_env max W L; reported, never scored
D6 modal projection of the recorded node depths onto the reference modes (energy per mode per window); reported

outputs: SCORED per case: representation-volume closure <V_b>_w3 against 180.0 m^3 (accounting; gate G-books)
SCORED per case: tank-mean level hbar_w3 against h_eq (numerical; gates G-level and W5)
SCORED per case: uniformity U_w3 (numerical; gates G-uniformity and G-reference; Passed or Insufficient reference data, see uniformityTiers); for N = 1 the two tanks only
SCORED per case: book stationarity across w1-w3, tiers (accounting; gate G-books)
SCORED per case (N >= 4): junction volume, every routing step (R4)
SCORED per case: sealing-weir flux, every step of the run, every step of the last window, and its integral (unchanged)
SCORED per case: tank node volume against A d, every step (unchanged)
VALIDITY per case: hard conditions V1-V4, stepping, G-node and G-link (unchanged); the gates with their values

REPORTED, NOT SCORED: C_fn, tau_U and its terms, E_h and its terms per window; D1-D6; SWMM's continuity error; the applied inflow; the instantaneous books and every PV-TF1 rest condition (comparison only)

REPORTED, NOT SCORED: the paired limiter effect per N, Delta_N = <V_b>_BOTH - <V_b>_NONE with uncertainty C_fn,BOTH + C_fn,NONE + both cases' D3 spreads; the D4 residual of both arms; the fill-phase limiter-condition counts under BOTH
REPORTED, NOT SCORED: the primary segmentation comparison (segmentationInterpretation)
REPORTED, NOT SCORED: per window, tau_U, R_U, the residual profile r_s and its cumulative form, the maximum Froude number per segment, and the depth range against G-depth
criteriaNotes: closureRel, equilibriumAbsM, sealFluxAbs, junctionVolumeAbsM3 and nodeVolumeRel are PV-C1's and PV-TF1's, unchanged since draft 1. M, K and beta are unchanged. eps, linearityFraction and shiftedWindows no longer enter any scored bound or validity condition (draft 3): they are diagnostic tolerances. The allowances are fixed formulas E3-E8 of the recorded state. PV-TF1's instantaneous rest criteria are reported for comparison only

segmentationInterpretation.N1: a separate reference case: a two-node system (no internal node) whose free motion is the two-node lumped mode (665.9 s); reported on its own and never placed on an N trend
segmentationInterpretation.comparability: two segmentations are dynamically comparable for a mode when their lumped periods for that mode differ from the continuum's by at most 2 eps (3 %). A priori (derived.json): N = 16 and 32 are comparable in modes 1-3; N = 4 in the fundamental only; N = 1 in none. This is a declared design rule on the reference models; it does not say that SWMM's own modes agree with them
rules: the N = 16 vs N = 32 difference is interpretable as a segmentation effect on storage
N = 4 is compared with them only for the cycle-averaged end state; fill-time differences involving N = 4 are reported, not attributed
no line, power law or extrapolation in N or 1/N is fitted; a direction is stated only where each successive difference exceeds the two cases' C_fn plus their D3 spreads
a case whose D2 period falls outside its tolerance is reported with that flag and is not used for a direction statement (a reporting rule; its scores stand)

predictions: P1 (open outfall explains T2-C): PRIMARY closes within the criterion at N = 4, 16, 32 (and at the N = 1 reference)
P2a (link storage carried by the end-node areas, J3): a closure offset of T2-C's sign, present at the N = 1 reference and at N = 4, smaller at 16 and 32, under PRIMARY

P2b (junction minimum surface area, J2): no offset at the N = 1 reference; an offset growing from N = 16 to N = 32 (and N = 4 below them), bounded by the J2 bound (1.8/8.9/18.3 m^3), and reduced in NONE-msa0.1
P3 (F1 excluded): the guards stay below 0.9 D (unchanged)
P4 (normal-flow limiter, F10): Delta_N exceeds its uncertainty at one or more N, and/or the BOTH arm shows a D4 residual absent under NONE; or no detectable difference
none of P1-P4 is a pass condition; rows are scored only against the criteria
outcomeInterpretation: DERIVATION.md section 9 (table); every row is limited to this closed, horizontal, part-full configuration, to the representation volume and to the end state; transientStatement applies
transientStatement: unchanged from PV-TF1: the closure in motion is diagnostic only; a cycle-averaged end state that closes does not establish that the transient was correct

failureClasses.accounting: representation-volume closure outside the criterion; book stationarity Failed; junction volume not 0; sealing weir flow not 0
failureClasses.numerical: level outside the criterion; books depending on the step beyond the criterion (dt0.5 diagnostic, reported). Since draft 3a a persistent hydraulic imbalance is not a Failed class (cycleAveragedEquilibrium.uniformityTiers)
failureClasses.invalidSetup: a hard validity condition, guard, stepping or sealing condition not met (unchanged)
failureClasses.insufficientReference: a gate not met; reported in sub-classes, never merged

insufficientSubclasses.IR-motion: the recorded motion is too large for the uniformity allowance (G-uniformity): the physical oscillation had not decayed enough
insufficientSubclasses.IR-redistribution: the measured junction redistribution and remainder exceed the level allowance (G-level): too much stored water displaced from the level state, by motion or imbalance, for the level row to reflect the closure
insufficientSubclasses.IR-reference: a condition of the source correspondence (Froude, depth) or the residual bound R_U fails (G-reference): the reference link equation does not explain the recorded mean state closely enough for its allowance to be used
insufficientSubclasses.IR-drift: the mean level was still moving beyond what the motion and the book drift explain (W5; level row only)
insufficientSubclasses.IR-definition: G-depth fails, or C_fn exceeds its gate: the closure would depend on the choice of representation volume, or dW/dy is not bounded on the recorded range
insufficientSubclasses.IR-imbalance (retired in draft 3a): the level row no longer presumes a level mean surface: E8 uses the measured redistribution
insufficientSubclasses.IR-basis (retired in draft 3): no scored row depends on the period or averaging assumptions any more; D2 and D3 anomalies are reported as flags beside the scores
insufficientSubclasses.distinctFrom: a Failed row is a genuine storage, conservation, level or balance violation with its gate met

conservation: closed system: the declared inflow is the only source, the sealing weir the only possible sink
resolution: N = 1 (reference), 4, 16, 32; fixed 1 s step; diagnostic 0.5 s
assumptions: the API reads are SWMM's state at the end of each routing step; every step of the scored and shifted windows and the step before them is recorded (PV-TF1 stepping, rawOutput)
limitations: the end state only; the transient is not scored

the closure is of the representation volume (R3''): the physical volume in motion is not testable from SWMM's state at this criterion (D5: the envelope class needs a_env <= 22.5 um, the monotone class 35 um at N = 1 to 1.1 mm at N = 32); at rest the two coincide

the uniformity allowance rests on the reference link equation E4 (R1''); the residual between SWMM's mean head differences and E4 is measured and gated (G-reference), not assumed. The uniformity row can no longer Fail: a persistent imbalance is reported as IR-reference with its residual profile
J2 (minimum surface area) is not directly observable; it is attributed through the N trend and the msa0.1 diagnostic
the limiter effect is measured as an end-state difference and through the D4 residual; whether the limiter fired at a given step is not observable (no getter)
48 h is a fixed maximum; if a gate is not met by then the outcome is Insufficient reference data in the stated sub-class, and the duration is not changed after the fact
Manning friction at mm/s velocities is outside its range of validity (F11): E4's friction term is the declared reference model, not a claim about water
D2 checks the T1 - T2 fundamental only; D3 has known blind spots; neither validates the modal content, and no scored row depends on them
the closure row is representation-volume closure; it is reported under that name, never as conservation of the physical water volume in motion

relationToFindings.F3: tested directly by P1, P2a, P2b; T2-C's registered rows stay Failed whatever the outcome
relationToFindings.F4: for the scored closure, removed by defining the reference on the representation volume; the physical in-motion volume remains unresolved and is reported (D5)
relationToFindings.F10: removed from the primary comparison by NONE; measured by the PAIRED configuration (P4, Delta_N and D4)
relationToFindings.F11: the oscillation is accepted as natural; its effect on the mean state is computed from the recorded motion instead of waited out or bounded by modal leakage
relationToFindings.PV-TF1 run 1: unchanged; see DERIVATION.md section 10 for what carries over

validRange: a horizontal circular conduit filled from dry to below 0.9 D, closed system, ends at prismatic storage, free motion small enough that the computed allowances meet their gates
scoring: automated, per case; PRIMARY and PAIRED tallied separately; status counts by error type and Insufficient sub-class; never a single pass percentage

rawOutput.everyStepChecks: all validity, guard, seal and stepping checks evaluated at every step for the full 48 h; all-step summaries kept
fullResolutionKept: every routing step of the K scored windows plus the 8 shifted windows and the step before them (the last 3 M T_ref + T_ref + 1 step)
the raw interval around any guard or validity trip, +- one T_ref
the complete configuration, generated .inp files and hashes
rawOutput.fullRecord: every step for the whole run archived outside git with SHA256SUMS committed, if practical
rawOutput.rule: the scored windows are never decimated

findingsRegisterRule: the PRIMARY (NONE) and PAIRED (BOTH) arms are reported as separate findings, never pooled: NONE answers the storage question without the normal-flow limiter, BOTH whether production's limiter changes it. A difference within the combined uncertainty is recorded as no detectable difference under this experiment, not as no effect

proposedCriteriaHistory.why: first proposal of revision 2; not hashed

proposedCriteriaHistory.criteria: criterion values unchanged; eps, linFrac and shifts reclassified as diagnostic tolerances; uniformity and stationarity thresholds redefined (CHANGELOG.md)
proposedCriteriaHistory.why: derivation revision after the technical review of draft 2: the scored bounds no longer depend on modal leakage, the period tolerance or the monotone-surface assumption

proposedCriteriaHistory.criteria: criterion values unchanged; new gates G-depth (0.1 D to 0.9 D) and G-reference (Froude <= 0.5, R_U <= beta headTol); uniformity tiers withdrawn; level allowance from the measured redistribution
